about: Non-Learn planning facts for the ESS planner. This file is NOT a business-scenario catalogue and MUST NOT enumerate which scenarios exist: per the PM spec (FR-1/FR-3), business scenarios come from the maker's own description grounded in Microsoft Learn. This file holds only the few facts the planner needs that are (a) NOT discoverable on Learn and (b) NOT a scenario list: scenario *dependencies* between two scenarios (applied only when both are named by the maker) and a small *recognition lexicon* used to spot role/output nouns when reading Learn pages. Every entry carries an explicit `source`. Keep this minimal and grounded; do not invent.

scenarioDependencies.rationale: Deploy knowledge before ticketing so the agent answers from knowledge first and only opens a ticket when the question is unresolved (deflection). NOTE: not found verbatim in the ADO planner PM spec (pm-spec.md) or spec repo as of 2026-08-04 — confirm the authoritative citation before presenting this as a spec requirement. Applies only when the maker puts both hr-ticketing and hr-knowledge in scope.

recognition.about: Vocabulary the planner uses to RECOGNISE roles/outputs while reading Learn pages. It does not define the roles/outputs — those are read from the page. Extend conservatively.
